parsedVerdict.reasoning: This module only declares the authentication module's outbound ports, and all three files serve that one concern. identity.gateway.ts (IdentityGateway, UserRecord, CreateUserInput) covers user identity. authorization.gateway.ts (AuthorizationGateway, RoleRecord) covers role assignment and lookup. jwt-signer.port.ts (JwtSignerPort and its payload and result types) covers token signing. No file repeats a rule or invariant from another: UserRecord and RoleRecord do not overlap, and the mustChangePassword claim rule is documented only in SignAccessTokenPayload. The use cases inject all three ports, and adapters and mocks implement them, so nothing bypasses the abstractions. There are three small inconsistencies. JwtSignerPort returns plain Promise<string> while the gateways return Result<..., InfrastructureError>. signCartSessionToken brings a cart concern into the auth signer, but it is still token signing. File suffixes mix .gateway.ts and .port.ts. None of these splits the module into unrelated concerns or duplicates a rule, so the unit passes.
